name: Idle Talk
overview: Scripture warns believers to carefully guard their speech, recognizing that excessive words often lead to sin, while restraint is a mark of wisdom and understanding. The heart of the righteous seeks thoughtful and knowledgeable responses, contrasting with the foolish and wicked whose mouths pour out folly and evil. Idle talk can sow discord and break friendships, emphasizing the importance of disciplined speech and the watchful guarding of one's lips as an expression of godly wisdom and righteousness.
